claim: Remark after Proposition 4 (st-tw fails for skew-t)
quote: It is worthwhile noting that the st - tw order does not hold for the skew-t since if U_i ~ chi^2_{nu_i}/nu_i for i = 1, 2, then E(U1) = E(U2) = 1. So, if S1 <=st S2 holds, from Theorem 1.A.3 in Shaked and Shanthikumar (2007, p. 6.), U1 >=st U2 holds. Therefore, taking into account Theorem 1.A.8 in Shaked and Shanthikumar (2007, p. 8.), we get U1 =^st U2; and thus S1 =^st S2 holds, i.e. nu_1 = nu_2.
